subject: HyphenWorks onboarding: PO issuance, spend cap mismatch, and quantity line correction
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@hyphen-works.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: HyphenWorks onboarding: PO issuance, spend cap mismatch, and quantity line correction

Hi Liam —

Thanks for submitting the onboarding packet. I reviewed the onboarding form and the PO request that was routed through our procurement system. Two issues popped up that are blocking final activation:

1) Spend cap mismatch: your onboarding form lists a requested spend cap of $100,000. Our procurement system currently shows a provisional cap of $20,000 (likely pulled from a default template). Can you confirm the desired monthly/annual cap? We need this to match before we issue the final PO.

2) Line item quantity: the "Cloud Inference - Dedicated vCPU hours" line shows quantity 250 in the system but the onboarding CSV lists 2,500. If the onboarding form is correct we need to correct the line item before PO finalization.

I've attached the onboarding form and the PO draft exported from our system (PO_58291_lineitems.csv) so you can see how it landed.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the official spend cap number and the intended quantity for the Cloud Inference line.
- Once confirmed, Procurement (Laura) will issue a provisional PO number and escalate to finance for the final limit.

If you want to hop on a quick call I can loop Priyom (onboarding) and Laura (procurement).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachments: HyphenWorks_onboarding_form.pdf, PO_58291_lineitems.csv
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@hyphen-works.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@hyphen-works.com>, finance@hyphen-works.com
Date: 2027-03-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HyphenWorks onboarding: PO issuance, spend cap mismatch, and quantity line correction

Ben —

Thanks for the heads up. Confirming the onboarding form is the source of truth: we requested a $100,000 annual spend cap in the form and the Cloud Inference SKU should be 2,500 vCPU hours (the 250 looks like a decimal/CSV import error). Apologies for the confusion.

We've attached the vendor W9 as well in case procurement needs it for vendor setup. Our finance contact Sara (cc'd) is on standby to approve final paperwork.

Can you and your procurement team provision a provisional PO at $100k so we can start onboarding while your finance team does the final review? If you need a purchase order memo or additional documents, let me know and Sara will provide.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, HyphenWorks
liam.oconnor@hyphen-works.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: RE: HyphenWorks onboarding: PO issuance, spend cap mismatch, and quantity line correction

Thanks Ben — I see the issue in the procurement intake: the onboarding form fields didn't map cleanly to our spend-cap enum, so the system applied the default $20k threshold. We need a manual override to set the requested $100k.

Proposal:
- Issue provisional PO: PO-58291-PROV (provisional) for $100,000 so HyphenWorks can begin onboarding. Flag the PO for manual review by Finance.
- Correct the line item quantity in the system to 2,500 and attach the corrected CSV (I will generate it).
- Once Finance signs off (Sara), we convert the provisional PO to a final PO and lock the spend cap.

I'll create the corrected CSV and route the provisional PO. Priyom, can you confirm HyphenWorks accepts a provisional PO and provide any extra paperwork we should attach?

Laura Bennett
Procurement Ops, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Date: 2027-03-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Updated PO and line items: provisional PO-58291-P1 issued

Hi Liam / Sara —

Thanks for confirming. We've issued a provisional PO to keep onboarding moving while Finance completes the final approval. Summary below:

- Provisional PO number: PO-58291-P1
- Temporary spend cap: $100,000 (annual)
- Corrected line item: Cloud Inference - Dedicated vCPU hours — quantity: 2,500
- Notes: Provisional PO will be converted to final PO after finance approval and DocuSign signature.

I've attached the corrected line-item CSV (PO_58291_lineitems.csv) with the updated quantities. Please confirm receipt and verify the quantities/costs so we can finalize. Once you confirm, Ben/Laura will route to Finance for sign-off.

If everything looks good we'll get a PDF generated and send it over via DocuSign for signature.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

Attachments: PO_58291_lineitems.csv

Request: can you send the DocuSign link and a final PDF copy of PO-58291-P1 so Sara can execute? We prefer DocuSign to keep audit trails intact.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to going live.
